7.
(1) A disposition of a security is carried out by means
of debit and credit posted to the transferor’s and transferee’s
respective securities account.
(2) Upon a disposition, the transferee acquires rights to
the extent of the interest transferred in the security that the
transferor had or had the power to transfer. Where the credit
for  the  interest  acquired  was  posted  to  the  transferee’s
securities  accounts,  and  the  transferee  gave  value  without
notice of any adverse claim, the transferee also acquires the
transferor’s interest in the security, free of any adverse claims.
